g.text: Dromos - Edit a saved route and recalculate automatically
Drag/drop, move, add, update or delete a stop
load route and existing stop coordinates
Only a newly added or changed address needs geocoding.
[Each overlapping section of at most 12 points]
transaction: update order, legs, totals and polyline(s)
updated order, totals and road-following map
Geocoding cache reduces address lookup calls.
It cannot remove the Routes API call required after the path changes.
